sources.name: Exophase
sources.note: Official trophy list: names, descriptions, grades.

sources.name: PSNProfiles
sources.note: Tracked counts behind the grind trophies.

trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the list. This is the last one by definition — work through the roadmap below and it unlocks on its own. Source: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles for the full checklist.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — play the story and it comes. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story trophy — keep playing the main story. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Story trophy — the last main-mission unlock before the clean-up stages. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. Story trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Story trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Story trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Story trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long clean-up trophy: it counts everything the game tracks — missions, activities, collectibles and side content. PSNProfiles tracks the checklist behind it; finish the other stages first and use the game's completion stat to find what is left. Source: Exophase (official list); PSNProfiles (completion tracking).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's trick moves — jumps, near-misses and air time while driving or riding. PSNProfiles counts 250; grind them anywhere with ramps and open roads, a few at a time between missions. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (250 count).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type once. There are 9 activity types in Leonida — play one of each (races, fishing, arcade, the range, drone races, bowling, meditation, hunting and one more the game lists). Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (9 types).
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 of them, per PSNProfiles. Take each range challenge one at a time; gold needs a clean, fast run, so learn the target pattern first and restart freely. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (42 challenges).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Drone races are short time trials; learn each course's line, then race it. PSNProfiles lists 14 locations. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (14 locations).
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts; 20 distinct race events. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish against Cal — the challenge is a head-to-head catch contest. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. Walk up to any arcade cabinet and play a game through to its end. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Story strand — play Andy's missions through to the last one. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Play Kenton's mission strand through to its last mission. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Play Billy's mission strand through to its last mission. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear on the map as you explore — each strand is a short chain; complete any 8. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (8 strands).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Play Randy's strand through to its last mission. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Play Tyrone's strand through to its last mission. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet places marked in the world — visit each and meditate. PSNProfiles counts 18. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (18 spots).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt asks for one specific animal — track it where Bret points you; the exact location is not pinned down in the sources we have, so follow Bret's directions in-game. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; a set is complete when every card in it is found. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It spots are scattered across the state — 100 of them, per PSNProfiles. Tick them off as you travel; the map fills in as you go. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (100 locations).
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives — 50 of them, per PSNProfiles. They accumulate across play; check the challenges list in-game to see which remain. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (50 challenges).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape. Get to 4 stars with your partner alongside, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the heat drops. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between them — plan a route of three close shops first. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 different vehicles — each new one you get into counts. PSNProfiles tracks 100. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (100 vehicles).
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies close together and land precise shooting — five downs before the focus ends. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: This is flagged missable from the description's wording — our reading is that it must be done during a specific VCIA moment, and the trigger is unconfirmed (the game released 2026-11-19). Do it the first time you are at the airport rather than assuming it can be done later. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos (tanks). Rhinos are the military tanks — the trophy's wording suggests taking one on or using one; the exact requirement is not pinned down in the sources we have. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses spotting you. Plan the entry and exit before you start. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault robberies, each with a clean escape. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck on the road and get away clean. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Visit every named area — 52 in total, per PSNProfiles. The map fills in as you travel; check it for blank regions. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (52 areas).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, per PSNProfiles. One operation per gang. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (9 gangs).
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable from the description's wording — our reading is that the cocktail moment is tied to a specific early scene, and the trigger is unconfirmed (the game released 2026-11-19). Take the cocktail when the chance first appears. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Flagged missable from the description's wording — our reading is that it belongs to a specific showroom moment, and the trigger is unconfirmed (the game released 2026-11-19). Do it when the showroom scene first comes up. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at that alley. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Flagged missable from the description's wording — our reading is that it is tied to a one-time partnership moment, and the trigger is unconfirmed (the game released 2026-11-19). Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: PSNProfiles tracks a count to 500 choices. Flagged missable from the description's wording — our reading is that some choices can only be made once, and the trigger is unconfirmed (the game released 2026-11-19). Make choices deliberately as you play rather than leaving them all to the end. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (500 choices).
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Flagged missable from the description's wording — our reading is that it requires succeeding on a second attempt at something, and the trigger is unconfirmed (the game released 2026-11-19). Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Flagged missable from the description's wording — our reading is that it is a one-time strange event, and the trigger is unconfirmed (the game released 2026-11-19). Keep an eye out for odd encounters while exploring. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Use a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills until the total hits $250,000 — it accumulates across the game. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles ($250,000).
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total at shops — it accumulates across the game. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles ($100,000).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them, per PSNProfiles. Buy every garage. Source: Exophase; PSNProfiles (8 garages).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten different vehicles in the app. Source: Exophase.
trophies.name: On the Spot
